crossRefs.note: and they will spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.
One will say, ‘I am Yahweh’s;’ and another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand…
“Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you.
But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the…
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin…
looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross…
But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable…
having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains…
For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower…
“It shall be eighteen thousand reeds around: and the name of the city from that day shall be, ‘Yahweh is there.’
I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail…
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
translations.bsb: And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”
translations.kjv: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish
translations.asv: Yea, of Zion it shall be said, This one and that one was born in her; And the Most High himself will establish her.
